capabilities: Shift the dashboard through four time-of-day modes (morning, day, evening, night)
Rank widgets by task urgency, with overdue tasks on top
Complete tasks in place by clicking a completion ring
Derive the active project from the most recently opened note (folder or frontmatter project)
Append quick thoughts as bullets to Capture.md
extras: Manifest states the plugin has not been reviewed by Obsidian staff. Installation is manual via unzipping release files into .obsidian/plugins/.
motivation: To surface what matters most right now instead of showing a static panel.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in start page that surfaces what matters right now; users must piece together tasks, deadlines, and recent notes from separate views.
summary: Context-adaptive dashboard that reconfigures its widgets by time of day, active project, and task priority.
